title: Deductible Taken Out Before Coinsurance on Insured Plan of Care Visits
content:
In reviewing a coinsurance charge on an Insured Plan of Care against the visit it belongs to, where the explanation of benefits applied a deductible to the reviewed visit, that deductible charge is taken out before the coinsurance percentage is applied; where no deductible charge but a deductible estimate was posted for that visit, the estimate is taken out instead; where neither was posted for that visit, nothing is taken out for the deductible.

Every amount taken out before the coinsurance percentage is applied is subtracted, together with any other such amount, from the amount the percentage is applied to; the remainder is never taken below zero, and the percentage then acts once on that remainder.

## Questions and answers

**Which deductible counts?** Only charges posted for the reviewed visit's date of service. A deductible charge posted from the explanation of benefits for that visit is used; where several such deductible charges stand for that date, they are taken together.

**What if both a deductible estimate and a deductible charge stand for the visit?** The deductible charge from the explanation of benefits is taken out, and the estimate is not taken out in addition.

**What if only a deductible estimate was collected for the visit?** The estimate is taken out.

**What if no deductible of either kind was posted for the visit?** Nothing is taken out for the deductible ($0.00).

## Hypothetical illustrations (coinsurance percentage 20%, amount the percentage is applied to $200.00)

| Posted for the reviewed visit | Taken out | Remainder | Coinsurance share on the remainder |
|---|---|---|---|
| Deductible charge $50.00 and deductible estimate $40.00 | $50.00 | $150.00 | $30.00 |
| Deductible estimate $40.00 only | $40.00 | $160.00 | $32.00 |
| Neither | $0.00 | $200.00 | $40.00 |
| Deductible charge $230.00 | $230.00 | $0.00 (never below zero) | $0.00 |
